Advantages: Avoids an additional compression step; useful as a reference encoding.
Tradeoffs: Large transfers and storage requirements; does not restore information previously lost.
Selection consideration: Use when the workflow prefers native pixels and bandwidth/storage permit.

Advantages: Simple, reversible run-length encoding; useful for data with repeated values.
Tradeoffs: Often a poor size reduction for detailed RGB photographs.
Selection consideration: Consider where explicitly supported; compare actual photo sizes before choosing.

Advantages: Established photographic encoding with adjustable quality/size tradeoffs.
Tradeoffs: Irreversible changes; blocking or ringing may appear at aggressive settings.
Selection consideration: Check the exact JPEG process, bit depth and destination support.

Advantages: Preserves input pixel values through a separate lossless JPEG process.
Tradeoffs: Not the same as ordinary lossy JPEG at maximum quality; requires its own decoder support.
Selection consideration: Useful when the archive supports the specific lossless JPEG transfer syntax.

Advantages: Supports exact reconstruction or bounded pixel error in near-lossless mode.
Tradeoffs: Near-lossless changes values; compatible decoding must be confirmed.
Selection consideration: Consider for exact preservation or an approved bounded-error workflow.

Advantages: Supports both fidelity modes with wavelet-based coding.
Tradeoffs: Processing cost and achieved size depend on implementation and settings.
Selection consideration: Evaluate where JPEG 2000 transfer syntaxes are supported.

Advantages: High-throughput JPEG 2000 coding designed for efficient processing.
Tradeoffs: Requires HTJ2K support; generic JPEG 2000 support is insufficient.
Selection consideration: Evaluate when processing throughput matters and both endpoints support it.

Advantages: Supports reversible and irreversible image coding; DICOM also defines JPEG recompression.
Tradeoffs: Verify the specific JPEG XL transfer syntax and receiving decoder.
Selection consideration: Consider where the full archive/viewer path has been validated.
